paragraphs.name: Technique
paragraphs.normal_text: Cardiac MRI at 1.5 T. Cine SSFP imaging in standard long- and short-axis planes, T2-weighted STIR, native T1 and T2 mapping, post-contrast T1 mapping and late gadolinium enhancement imaging following 0.1 mmol/kg gadobutrol.

paragraphs.name: Left ventricle
paragraphs.normal_text: The left ventricle is normal in size and wall thickness with preserved systolic function and no regional wall motion abnormality. LVEDVi 88 ml/m², LVESVi 33 ml/m², LVEF 62%, LV mass index 58 g/m².

paragraphs.name: Right ventricle
paragraphs.normal_text: The right ventricle is normal in size with preserved systolic function. RVEDVi 92 ml/m², RVESVi 40 ml/m², RVEF 57%.

paragraphs.name: Atria and valves
paragraphs.normal_text: The atria are not dilated. No significant valvular regurgitation or stenosis.

paragraphs.name: Pericardium and extracardiac
paragraphs.normal_text: No pericardial effusion. No significant extracardiac findings.

paragraphs.name: Tissue characterisation
paragraphs.normal_text: Native T1 985 ms (local reference range 950–1050 ms at 1.5 T). T2 48 ms (local reference range 42–52 ms). ECV 26% (normal <30%). No myocardial oedema.

paragraphs.name: Late gadolinium enhancement
paragraphs.normal_text: No late gadolinium enhancement. No intracardiac thrombus.

paragraphs.name: Conclusion
paragraphs.normal_text: Normal cardiac MRI. No evidence of cardiomyopathy.

expected_per_dictation.notes: Viability protocol: technique replaced, Tissue characterisation section omitted (its negative goes with it), 'Values not provided: LV mass index, RVEDVi, RVESVi, RVEF.' at top of Findings, RV described visually. Apex akinetic so 'No intracardiac thrombus.' becomes 'No apical thrombus on early or late post-contrast imaging.' (dictation says no thrombus). Subendocardial LGE triggers the viability APPEND. IF_PRESENT P20 not applicable (ischaemic LGE).

Normal study: standard technique, all seven ventricular values present (no missing line), all NORMAL/NEGATIVE units stand, unnumbered conclusion 'Normal cardiac MRI. No evidence of cardiomyopathy.' Max wall 10 mm is not hypertrophy, so P21 and P22 must not fire despite the HCM family history.

negatives_omitted: No apical thrombus on early or late post-contrast imaging.
expected_per_dictation.notes: Tricky: the dictation never says 'thrombus' - a non-enhancing 11 x 7 mm filling defect adherent to the akinetic apex on early and late gadolinium IS an apical thrombus. P18's condition is met (apical akinesia) but both its target and its replacement wording are contradicted, so neither may be written; the thrombus is described from the dictation and belongs in the conclusion. Viability APPEND fires (subendocardial LGE). Full protocol, values complete, ECV normal (no P15).
